settings.text:
Write your story here in your own words: where you started, what you make now and who it is for.

I teach drawing to grown ups who stopped at school. I write the Sunday Sketch letter, run The Drawing Table and make short videos about pens, paper and patience. I live with a cat who sits on whatever page I am working on.
